name: ultragoal
description: Turn a written plan into a self-enforcing run: compiles the plan's acceptance criteria into a machine-checkable rubric, then a Stop hook blocks the session from stopping until every check passes on disk — feeding failing checks back as the next marching order. Hash-pinned judge, bounded enforcement, human escape verb. After Karpathy's autoresearch recipe: start --iterate N re-arms on each certified DONE.
